1.name: Acid Blood
1.effect: Your blood is caustic. Creatures that attack you in melee suffer d4 acid damage when they damage you.

2.name: Adhesive Touch
2.effect: Your hands and feet are like those of a gecko. You can climb any surface and crawl across ceilings.

3.name: Albino
3.effect: Your body has no pigmentation. You must carry a sunshade (1 slot) or suffer DIS on all Saves during daylight hours.

4.name: Antlers
4.effect: You have antlers like an elk or moose. Make an extra +d6 melee attack when you charge.

5.name: Analgesia
5.effect: You are unable to feel pain. You do not know your maximum or current HP; the Referee tracks both.

6.name: Armoured Skin
6.effect: Your body is protected by natural armour. Add +2 to your base AV.

7.name: Backwards Head
7.effect: Your head can swivel backwards like an owl's. You cannot be ambushed.

8.name: Backwards Legs
8.effect: Your legs are backwards. DIS when fleeing and sneaking.

9.name: Beak
9.effect: Make an extra d6 melee attack. ADV on reaction rolls when encountering bird-like creatures.

10.name: Bioelectricity
10.effect: Your unarmed melee attack causes +d6 electrical damage.

11.name: Bioluminescence
11.effect: Your flesh produces a faint glow. You always have a light source. DIS to hide at night.

12.name: Blind
12.effect: You cannot see and must navigate by sound and scent. DIS on ranged attacks, ADV when fighting in the dark. Cancels effects of other visual mutations.

13.name: Body Barbs
13.effect: Your flesh is studded with sharp barbs. Opponents who miss melee attacks against you suffer damage equal to your Level.

14.name: Bulbous Eyes
14.effect: Your eyes are enormous. DIS on Saves to avoid blindness.

15.name: Centaur
15.effect: You have the lower body and legs of a horse. +2 CON, +4 max items slots (24 total).

16.name: Chameleon Skin
16.effect: Your skin always matches its surroundings. ADV to conceal yourself.

17.name: Claws, Crab
17.effect: One hand is a huge crab-like claw. Your unarmed attack deals d8 damage. You cannot use two-handed weapons.

18.name: Claws, Retractable
18.effect: You have retractable feline claws. Your unarmed attack deals d6 damage.

19.name: Clubfoot
19.effect: One foot is larger and heavier than the other. DIS when fleeing and sneaking.

20.name: Compound Eyes
20.effect: Your eyes are like those of a fly. +1 DEX.

21.name: Crest, Bone
21.effect: You have a large bony crest on your head. +1 AV. Cannot wear helmets.

22.name: Crest, Feathers
22.effect: You have a crest of feathers on your head. +1 EGO. Cannot wear helmets.

23.name: Crown, Horns
23.effect: You have a crown of horns on your head. +1 AV. Cannot wear helmets.

24.name: Crown, Coral
24.effect: You have a coral-like crown on your head. +1 AV. Cannot wear helmets.

25.name: Crown, Eyestalks
25.effect: You have a crown of eyestalks on your head. +1 PSY. Cannot wear helmets.

26.name: Cyclops Eye
26.effect: You have a single huge eye. You have poor depth perception. DIS on Saves vs blindness.

27.name: Detachable Head
27.effect: Your head can detach from your body and move of its own accord for as long as you can hold your breath.

28.name: Detachable Limb
28.effect: A single limb can detach from your body and move of its own accord. If separated from your body it cannot 'see' and must proceed by touch alone.

29.name: Double Muscled
29.effect: Your limbs have an extra pair of muscles. +2 STR, ADV when fleeing or pursuing.

30.name: Echolocation
30.effect: You can 'see' in pitch darkness using echoes. You cannot be blinded and have ADV when fighting in the dark.

31.name: Exposed Organs
31.effect: You suffer double damage from slashing or piercing attacks.

32.name: Extra Arms
32.effect: You have an extra pair of arms. You can make an extra melee or ranged attack each turn, if equipped with a second weapon.

33.name: Extra Eyes
33.effect: You have d3 extra eyes on your forehead. +1 PSY for each.

34.name: Extra Head
34.effect: You have an extra head. ADV on INT, PSY and EGO Saves. You can survive one decapitation.

36.name: Extra Legs
36.effect: You have a pair of extra legs. +2 CON, ADV on Saves relating to pursuits.

37.name: Extra Liver
37.effect: ADV on Saves vs poisons and TOX attacks.

38.name: Eyestalks
38.effect: Your eyes extend out of their sockets on stalks.

39.name: Fangs, Venomous
39.effect: You have a poisonous bite (d6 TOX).

40.name: Feathers
40.effect: You have feathers instead of hair. ADV to reaction roll when encountering feathered creatures.

41.name: Frog Tongue
41.effect: Your tongue is extremely long and sticky. DEX save to snatch weapons from foe's hands.

42.name: Fur
42.effect: You are covered in fur. ADV to reaction roll when encountering furry creatures.

43.name: Gills
43.effect: You have gills and can breathe underwater. You must drink double rations of water each day or become Deprived.

44.name: Gliding Membranes
44.effect: You have membranes between your arms and torso and can glide for short distances.

45.name: Goat Legs
45.effect: You have the legs and hooves of a goat. You can walk up sheer surfaces.

46.name: Headless
46.effect: You have no head; your face is on your torso. You cannot wear helmets or hats.

47.name: Heightened Hearing
47.effect: You have extremely sharp hearing. You suffer no ill-effects from blindness or darkness and cannot be ambushed.

48.name: Heightened Immune System
48.effect: Your immune system is the envy of all. ADV on Saves vs diseases and poisons.

49.name: Hook, Climbing
49.effect: You have hook-like protrusions on your limbs. ADV to climbing and acrobatics.

50.name: Hopper
50.effect: You have a single, powerful leg. You can leap huge distances.

51.name: Horns, Ram
51.effect: You have ram-like horns. You can make an extra d6 melee attack. ADV on reaction rolls when encountering other horned creatures.

52.name: Horns, Rhino
52.effect: You have a single rhino-like horn. When you charge into melee range, add +d10 to your damage roll.

53.name: Huge Beard
53.effect: You have a gigantic, fast-growing beard that resists all attempts to tame it.

54.name: Huge Brain
54.effect: Your head is enormous. +2 to INT. You cannot wear helmets or hats.

55.name: Humpback
55.effect: You have a hump like that of a camel, which stores water. You can go seven days without drinking water.

56.name: Infravision
56.effect: You can detect heat signatures and can see warm-blooded creatures in total darkness.

57.name: Ink Ducts
57.effect: You can spray out ink like a squid, causing an opponent to DEX save vs blindness. You can do this a number of times per day equal to your Level.

58.name: Insulated Skin
58.effect: Your skin is resistant to heat and cold. Take half damage from extreme temperatures.

59.name: Kangaroo Pouch
59.effect: You have a torso-pouch like a kangaroo's. +2 max item slots (22 max).

60.name: Larynx Darts
60.effect: You can cough bony barbs from a discreet orifice in your neck. Treat as a concealed d4 ranged weapon that cannot run out of ammunition.

61.name: Leaves
61.effect: You have leaves instead of hair. Regain d4 HP per hour when resting in sunlight.

62.name: Malleable Body
62.effect: Your body is rubbery and malleable; you can fit into tight gaps. Take half damage from bludgeoning attacks.

63.name: Malleable Face
63.effect: Your face is malleable; you can imitate the faces of others given time.

64.name: Mane, Hair
64.effect: You have a lion-like mane of hair around your neck. +1 EGO.

65.name: No Ears
65.effect: You have no external ears; just holes.

66.name: Obligate Carnivore
66.effect: You must eat raw meat each day or become Deprived.

67.name: Patterned Skin
67.effect: Your skin is striped or spotted. +1 EGO.

68.name: Pleasant Fragrance
68.effect: Your scent is pleasing to all. +1 EGO.

69.name: Poison Spur
69.effect: You have a poison spur on your wrist. Your unarmed attack deals d6 TOX damage.

70.name: Powerful Jaws
70.effect: You can bite through metal. Add +d6 to melee attack damage.

71.name: Prehensile Feet
71.effect: Your feet can grip objects like hands. +1 DEX.

72.name: Prehensile Hair
72.effect: Your hair can grip objects like a hand. +1 DEX.

73.name: Quills
73.effect: You have quills coating your body. Add +2 to your AV. Opponents who miss melee attacks against you suffer damage equal to your Level. You cannot wear other armour.

74.name: Scaly Skin
74.effect: Your skin is thick and scaly. Add +1 to your AV.

75.name: Silk Production
75.effect: You can produce strands of sticky web. Make an opposed DEX save to wrap an enemy in web, paralysing them until they succeed at a DEX save.

76.name: Skeletal Frame
76.effect: Your body is incredibly light. -2 STR and -2 CON. You take double damage from bludgeoning and crushing attacks.

77.name: Slimy Skin
77.effect: You are coated in slime. ADV to escape grab attacks and enclosing traps.

78.name: Slug Body
78.effect: You have a single slimy tail-foot and leave a trail of mucus. -2 DEX, can stick to sheer surfaces.

79.name: Small Stature
79.effect: Your body is child-sized and will never grow larger. DIS on all STR saves.

80.name: Snout
80.effect: You have a snout-like, animalistic face. ADV to reaction rolls with Newbeasts.

81.name: Stilt Legs
81.effect: You have long stilt-like legs. ADV in chases and pursuits, can wade quickly through flooded areas. You are the default target for ranged attacks.

82.name: Strange-Hued Eyes
82.effect: Your eyes are an unnatural colour.

83.name: Strange-Hued Hair
83.effect: Your hair is an unnatural colour.

84.name: Strange-Hued Skin
84.effect: Your skin is an unnatural colour.

85.name: Tail, Club
85.effect: You have a club-like, heavy tail. Make an extra d8 crushing melee attack per round.

86.name: Tail, Prehensile
86.effect: You have a long, thin tail that can grip objects. +2 DEX.

87.name: Tail, Scorpion
87.effect: You have a segmented stinging tail like a scorpion's. Make one extra attack per round (d6 TOX).

88.name: Tentacles, Arms
88.effect: You have tentacles instead of arms. -3 STR, +3 DEX.

89.name: Tentacles, Hair
89.effect: You have stinging tentacles instead of hair. At melee range you can make a d6 TOX attack instead of your normal attack.

90.name: Toxic Flesh
90.effect: Your flesh is toxic when eaten (d10 TOX).

91.name: Transparent Skin
91.effect: Your skin is transparent and your muscles and veins can be seen. Take double damage from Beam attacks.

92.name: Trunk
92.effect: You have an elephant-like trunk, which can hold and manipulate objects. +1 DEX.

93.name: Tusks
93.effect: You have tusks like a boar. +D6 melee damage.

94.name: Ultravision
94.effect: You have eyes that see beyond the normal spectrum of light. You can see otherwise invisible creatures and objects. You cannot be blinded.

96.name: Vocal Mimic
96.effect: You can perfectly mimic voices or sounds you have heard.

97.name: Warty Skin
97.effect: Your skin is thick and warty. Add +1 to your AV.

98.name: Webbed Digits
98.effect: Your hands and feet are webbed like a frog's.

99.name: Whiskers
99.effect: You have sensitive whiskers like a cat. +1 PSY.

100.name: Wings
100.effect: You have wings that allowed you to fly freely. When airborne you are the default target for ranged attacks.
